user.title: Ultimate II+ / Ultimate 64
user.description: Enter the network address of your Ultimate device. Web Remote Control must be enabled in the Ultimate menu.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Ultimate II+ cartridge or Ultimate 64.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the REST API, 80 by default.
data_description.password: Only needed if a network password is set on the device (firmware 3.12+).
data_description.name: Name of the device in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Ultimate network password
reauth_confirm.description: The Ultimate refused the request. Enter the current network password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check host, port and that the device is switched on.
error.not_an_ultimate: The host answered, but it does not look like an Ultimate device.

abort.already_configured: This Ultimate device is already configured.

init.title: UltimateControl options
init.description: Polling interval, the network password, and an optional folder on the Home Assistant host whose SID files are copied into the favourites.

data_description.favorites_folder: Absolute path, e.g. /config/media/favorites. Its SID files are copied into the favourites folder on save; leave empty to manage favourites from the dashboard.

import_folder.name: SID folder import
import_folder.description: Copy every SID file of a folder on the Home Assistant host into the local SID library.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Ultimate device the library belongs to.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Absolute path on the Home Assistant host.
